changedCandidateFields.sourceEnglish: Water composition and product effects vary, so the actual source and products need assessment
changedCandidateFields.currentTarget: Water composition and product effects vary, kutani the actual source and products need assessment.
changedCandidateFields.proposedTarget: Water composition na effects ta products swa hambana; hikokwalaho source ya xiviri na products swi lava assessment.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mofuta o mong wa swale ke level trench on contour. E fokotsa lebelo mme e hasanya runoff, hore metsi a mang a kgone ho kenella mobung o loketseng. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Mokgwa o loketseng naha ya hao o itshetlehile ka mobu, slope, drainage le storm flow. Pele o tjheka, trained local adviser a hlahlobe line, overflow le receiving point.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mofuta o mong wa swale ke a level trench on contour. E fokotsa lebelo mme e hasanya runoff, hore metsi a mang a kgone ho kenella mobung o loketseng. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Mokgwa o loketseng naha ya hao o itshetlehile ka mobu, slope, drainage le storm flow. Pele o tjheka, kopa trained local adviser hore a hlahlobe line, overflow le receiving point.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The excavated soil forms a berm on the downhill side, where trees can be planted when the site design is suitable.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mobu o epolotsweng o etsa berm on the downhill side; moo difate di ka jalwang ha site design e loketse.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mobu o epolotsweng o etsa berm ka lehlakoreng le theohelang, moo difate di ka jalwang teng ha site design e loketse.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Trees planted there may draw on moisture stored in the soil after rain, depending on the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Difate tse jetsweng moo di ka nka moisture e bolokilweng mobung ka mora pula, ho ya ka site.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Difate tse jalwang moo di ka sebedisa metsi a bolokilweng mobung ka mora pula, ho ya ka site.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Pula e matla e ka tlatsa swale ka potlako ho feta kamoo metsi a kenellang mobung. Rera safe overflow pele o tjheka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Pula e matla e ka tlatsa swale ka potlako ho feta kamoo metsi a kenellang mobung. Rala tsela e bolokehileng ya overflow pele o tjheka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Route eo ha e a tshwanela ho senya slope ka erosion kapa ho romela metsi a senyang ho moahisani. Downstream swale kapa dam e lokela ho kgona ho amohela metsi ao ka polokeho.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tsela ha e a lokela ho baka erosion moepeng kapa ho romela metsi a senyang ho moahisani. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Kopa trained local adviser hore a hlahlobe mobu, slope le storm flow. Setshwantsho ha se construction design.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Kopa trained local adviser hore a hlahlobe mobu, slope le storm flow. Setshwantsho hase construction design.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Slope feela ha e bolele hore swale e a lokela. Soil, drainage, unstable ground le metsi a tswang upslope kaofela di bohlokwa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Slope feela ha e bolele hore swale e loketse. Soil, drainage, unstable ground le metsi a tswang upslope kaofela di bohlokwa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Boloka ground cover e ntle. Fumana local assessment pele o tjheka mobung o steep, wet kapa unstable. Grass barriers le terraces le tsona di hloka design e loketseng site.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Boloka ground cover e ntle. Fumana local assessment pele o tjheka sebakeng se steep, wet kapa unstable. Grass barriers le terraces le tsona di hloka design e loketseng site.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam or pond can store runoff, but the amount available depends on local rain, the catchment, losses and how much water you use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Letamo kapa letangwana le ka boloka metsi a phallang, empa bongata bo fumanehang bo itshetlehile ka pula ya sebaka seo, sebaka se kgoboketsang metsi (catchment), tahlehelo le hore na o sebedisa metsi a makae.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Letamo kapa letangwana le ka boloka metsi a phallang, empa bongata bo fumanehang bo itshetlehile ka pula ya sebaka seo, sebaka se kgoboketsang metsi (catchment), tahlehelo le hore na o sebedisa metsi a makae.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Rainfall seasons differ across South Africa. Use local records and plan for dry periods; a full dam is not guaranteed.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Dihla tsa pula di fapana ho pholletsa le Afrika Borwa (South Africa). Sebedisa ditlaleho tsa sebaka seo mme o rale bakeng sa dry periods; letamo le tletseng ha le a tiisetswa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Dihla tsa pula di fapana ho pholletsa le Afrika Borwa (South Africa). Sebedisa ditlaleho tsa sebaka seo mme o rale bakeng sa dry periods; letamo le tletseng ha le a tiisetswa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before changing a watercourse or building storage works, check the required authorisation with the water authority.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Pele o fetola tsela ya noka kapa molatswana (watercourse) kapa o haha meaho ya polokelo, hlahloba tumello e hlokahalang le balaodi ba metsi.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Pele o fetola tsela ya noka kapa molatswana (watercourse) kapa o haha meaho ya polokelo, hlahloba tumello e hlokahalang le balaodi ba metsi.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam needs a site investigation and a design by a suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk and a safe spillway all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Letamo le hloka dipatlisiso tsa setsha le moralo o entsweng ke motho ya nang le ditshwaneleho tse loketseng. Metsi a phallang ho tswa sebakeng sa pokellelo (catchment runoff), mobu, metheo, kotsi e ka tlase (downstream risk) le tsela e bolokehileng ya metsi a tletseng (safe spillway) kaofela a bohlokwa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Letamo le hloka dipatlisiso tsa setsha le moralo o entsweng ke motho ya nang le ditshwaneleho tse loketseng. Metsi a phallang ho tswa sebakeng sa pokellelo (catchment runoff), mobu, metheo, kotsi e ka tlase (downstream risk) le tsela e bolokehileng ya metsi a tletseng (safe spillway) kaofela a bohlokwa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not assume that annual rainfall tells you the size of a flood or the storage you will have.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: O se ke wa nka hore pula ya selemo le selemo e o jwetsa boholo ba morwallo kapa polokelo eo o tla ba le yona.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: O se ke wa nka hore pula ya selemo le selemo e o jwetsa boholo ba morwallo kapa polokelo eo o tla ba le yona.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Plan a safe route for excess water before construction.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Phallo e sa laolweng ya metsi a tletseng e ka kgohola le ho pshatla lerako. Rala tsela e bolokehileng bakeng sa metsi a feteletseng pele ho kaho.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Phallo e sa laolweng ya metsi a tletseng e ka kgohola le ho pshatla lerako. Rala tsela e bolokehileng bakeng sa metsi a feteletseng pele ho kaho.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water can be lost through evaporation and seepage. Check the water level and look for leaks or erosion.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Metsi a ka lahleha ka evaporation and seepage. Hlahloba boemo ba metsi mme o batle dibaka tse dutlang kapa kgoholeho.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Metsi a ka lahleha ka evaporation le seepage. Hlahloba boemo ba metsi mme o batle dibaka tse dutlang kapa kgoholeho.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. O se ke wa jala difate hodima lerako la letamo la mobu.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Boloka spillway e sa thibehang mme o hlokomele bank cover e boletsweng design. O se ke wa jala difate hodima lerako la earth dam.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Their presence does not make the water clean or safe.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Diphoofolo di ka senya mabopo mme tsa eketsa mantle ka hara metsi. Ho ba teng ha tsona ha ho etse hore metsi a hlweke kapa a bolokehe.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Diphoofolo di ka senya mabopo mme tsa eketsa mantle ka hara metsi. Ho ba teng ha tsona ha ho etse hore metsi a hlweke kapa a bolokehe.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Marulelo a hao a ka bokella metsi a pula. Bongata bo itshetlehile ka boholo ba marulelo, pula le tahlehelo.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Marulelo a hao a ka bokella metsi a pula. Bongata bo itshetlehile ka boholo ba marulelo, pula le tahlehelo.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Check whether the roof material is suitable for rainwater collection before connecting a tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Hlahloba hore na thepa ya marulelo e loketse ho bokella metsi a pula pele o hokela tanka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Hlahloba hore na thepa ya marulelo e loketse ho bokella metsi a pula pele o hokela tanka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Ebe o dumella metsi a fosang koto, a kgelohang kapa a kgaphatsehang ha tanka e tletse.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Bapisa phepelo le tshebediso eo o e rerileng.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Palo ya pula ya selemo kaofela ha e o bolelle hore na metsi a makae a tla fumaneha nakong ya dry spell. Bapisa phepelo le ditshebediso tseo o di rerileng.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. Sekgelo sa ho qala ha phallo (first-flush diverter) se boloka karolo e nngwe ya metsi a pele a phallang kantle ho tanka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Bongata bo hlokahalang ba ho kgeloha bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le tsamaiso. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Bongata bo lokelang ho kgeloswa bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le system. Latela ditaelo tsa supplier tsa sizing le maintenance; ha ho volume e le nngwe bakeng sa marulelo ohle.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A diverter does not make the remaining water safe to drink.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Sekgelo (diverter) ha se etse hore metsi a setseng a bolokehele ho nowa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Sekgelo (diverter) ha se etse hore metsi a setseng a bolokehele ho nowa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Boholo ba tanka bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, boholo ba marulelo le the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Boholo ba tank bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, sebaka sa marulelo le bolelele ba dry periods.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ngola tshebediso e rerilweng mme o hakanye tlhoko ya yona ho tswa ditlalehong tsa hao. Bapisa seo le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ngola intended uses mme o hakanye demand ya tsona o sebedisa records tsa hao. Bapisa phepelo le ditshebediso tseo ho pholletsa le dihla.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a qala ho fela. Lebitso la provense feela le ke ke la o jwetsa boholo ba tanka eo o e hlokang.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a fokotseha. Lebitso la provense feela ha le bolele boholo ba tank boo o bo hlokang.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Boloka tanka e kwahetswe, screen openings against insects, mme o hlokomele marulelo, dikoto le sekgelo (diverter). Boloka metsi a pula a arohane le diphaephe tsa metsi a nowang.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Kwahela tank, kwahela masoba ka mesh e thibelang dikokonyana, mme o hlokomele marulelo, gutters le diverter. Arola metsi a pula le diphaephe tsa drinking water.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka diteko le kalafo tse loketseng tshebediso e rerilweng.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Metsi a shebahalang a hlakile a ntse a ka ba le germs kapa chemicals. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka testing le treatment tse loketseng intended use.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Sefa sa mantlha feela hase tiiso ya metsi a nowang. Metsi a sebediswang dijalong tsa dijo le ona a hloka tlhahlobo ya polokeho.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Sefa sa mantlha feela hase tiiso ya metsi a nowang. Metsi a sebediswang dijalong tsa dijo le ona a hloka tlhahlobo ya polokeho.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Metsi a sebedisitsweng a lapeng a ka ba le dikokwana-hloko, matswai, dihlahiswa tsa ho hlwekisa le dintho tse ding. Ditaelo ha di hlalose mohlodi o mong le o mong ka mokgwa o tshwanang. Ditaelo tsa Afrika Borwa di fapana mabapi le kitchen water le laundry water.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Metsi a sebedisitsweng ka lapeng a ka ba le germs, salts, cleaning products le dintho tse ding. Ditaelo ha di hlalose mohlodi o mong le o mong ka tsela e tshwanang. Ditaelo tsa Afrika Borwa di fapana mabapi le kitchen water le laundry water.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: O se ke wa kenya toilet water, water from nappies, a ho hlatswa motho ya kulang kapa a ho hlatswa diphoofolo moralong wa reuse. O se ke wa sebedisa hape metsi a nang le harmful chemicals.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Pele ho reuse efe kapa efe, kopa municipality le qualified local sanitation adviser hore ba hlahlobe source e tobileng, ditshebeletso tsa metsi le sanitation tsa household, intended use le site. Haeba keletso ena e sa fumanehe kapa e sa hlaka, o se ke wa sebedisa metsi hape.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Setshwantsho se akaretsang ha se moralo wa polasi. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Setshwantsho se akaretsang hase farm design. Soil le mulch ha di disinfect wastewater. Boloka wastewater hole le drinking-water plumbing mme o thibele ho kopana ha yona le batho kapa diphoofolo. O se ke wa e fafatsa, wa e tlohela e eme, kapa wa dumella hore e phalle kantle ho property ho kena seterateng, drain kapa watercourse.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, emisa ho e sebedisa mme seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa mme metsi a nkha hampe, a etsa letamo kapa a senya dimela, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. I fhungudza luvhilo na u phaḓaladza runoff, uri maḓi maṅwe a kone u dzhena kha suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Lushaka luthihi lwa swale ndi a level trench on contour. I fhungudza luvhilo na u phaḓaladza runoff, uri maḓi maṅwe a kone u dzhena kha suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Nḓila ine ya fanelea shango ḽaṋu i bva kha soil, slope, drainage na storm flow. Musi ni sa athu u bwa, humbelani trained local adviser uri a sedze line, overflow na receiving point.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The excavated soil forms a berm on the downhill side, where trees can be planted when the site design is suitable.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mavu o excavated a vhumba berm on the downhill side, hune trees can be planted when the site design is suitable.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mavu o excavated a vhumba berm nga thungo ya le downhill, hune miri ya nga ṱavhiwa arali site design yo tea.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Trees planted there may draw on moisture stored in the soil after rain, depending on the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Miri yo ṱavhiwaho henefho may draw on moisture stored in the soil after rain, depending on the site.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Miri yo ṱavhiwaho henefho i nga shumisa moisture yo vhulungwaho mavuni nga murahu ha mvula, zwi tshi ya nga site.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Pula khulwane i nga ḓadza swale nga u ṱavhanya u fhira u dzhena ha maḓi mavuni. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Pulani safe overflow ni sa athu u bwa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. Swale kana dam ya fhasi i tea u kona u ṱanganedza maḓi ayo nga vhuḓi.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a assess soil, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale i suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale i suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa a design suited to the site.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha fhethu ha steep, wet kana unstable. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam or pond can store runoff, but the amount available depends on local rain, the catchment, losses and how much water you use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Dam kana pond i nga vhulunga runoff, fhedzi amount i re hone i bva kha local rain, catchment, losses na uri ni shumisa maḓi mangana.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Dam kana pond i nga vhulunga runoff, fhedzi maḓi ane a wanala a bva kha mvula ya henefho, catchment, losses na uri ni shumisa maḓi mangana.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Rainfall seasons differ across South Africa. Use local records and plan for dry periods; a full dam is not guaranteed.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tshifhinga tsha mvula tshi a fhambana u mona na Afurika Tshipembe. Shumisani local records ni pulanele dry periods; dam yo ḓalaho a yo khwaṱhisedzwi.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tshifhinga tsha mvula tshi a fhambana u mona na Afurika Tshipembe. Shumisani local records nahone ni pulanele dry periods; dam yo ḓalaho a yo khwaṱhisedzwi.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before changing a watercourse or building storage works, check the required authorisation with the water authority.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Musi ni sa athu shandula watercourse kana u fhaṱa storage works, check the required authorisation with the water authority.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Musi ni sa athu u shandula watercourse kana u fhaṱa storage works, ṱolani authorisation ine ya ṱoḓea kha water authority.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam needs a site investigation and a design by a suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk and a safe spillway all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Dam i ṱoḓa site investigation na design yo itwaho nga suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Dam i ṱoḓa site investigation na design yo itwaho nga suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not assume that annual rainfall tells you the size of a flood or the storage you will have.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ni songo humbula uri annual rainfall i ni vhudza size ya flood kana storage ine na ḓo vha nayo.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ni songo humbula uri annual rainfall i ni vhudza size ya flood kana storage ine na ḓo vha nayo.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Plan a safe route for excess water before construction.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Overflow i songo langiwaho i nga erode na breach wall. Plan safe route ya excess water before construction.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Overflow i songo langiwaho i nga erode na breach wall. Pulani safe route ya excess water ni sa athu u thoma construction.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water can be lost through evaporation and seepage. Check the water level and look for leaks or erosion.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Maḓi a nga xela nga evaporation na seepage. Check water level ni sedze leaks kana erosion.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Maḓi a nga xela nga evaporation na seepage. Sedzani water level, ni ṱole leaks kana erosion.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Keep spillway i clear nahone maintain bank cover yo bulwaho kha design. Do not plant trees on earth dam wall.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Ni songo ṱavha trees kha earth dam wall.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Their presence does not make the water clean or safe.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. U vha hone hazwi iti uri maḓi a vhe clean kana safe.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. U vha hone hadzo a hu iti uri maḓi a vhe clean kana safe.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ṱhanga ya ṋu i nga kuvhanganya madi a mvula. Madi ane a wanala a bva kha vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga, mvula na madi a xelaho.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ṱhanga ya ṋu i nga kuvhanganya madi a mvula. Madi ane a wanala a bva kha vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga, mvula na madi a xelaho.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Check whether the roof material is suitable for rainwater collection before connecting a tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ṱolani arali roof material yo tea u kuvhanganya maḓi a mvula musi ni sa athu u ṱumanya tank.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ṱolani arali roof material yo tea u kuvhanganya maḓi a mvula musi ni sa athu u ṱumanya tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Shumisani roof area ine ya vhonala u bva nṱha na local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Shumisani roof area ine ya vhonala u bva nṱha na local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tshivhalo tsha ṅwaha woṱhe a tshi ni vhudzi uri hu ḓo vha na madi mangana during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tshivhalo tsha ṅwaha woṱhe a tshi ni vhudzi uri hu ḓo vha na maḓi mangana kha dry spell. Vhambedzani supply na mishumo ine na pulana u shumisa maḓi hayo.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Roof runoff i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a first runoff uri a si dzhene kha tank.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Roof runoff i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a first runoff uri a si dzhene kha tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Diversion ine ya ṱoḓea i ḓitika nga ṱhanga na system. Shumisani ndaela dza supplier dza sizing na maintenance; a hu na volume nthihi fhedzi ine ya shuma kha ṱhanga iṅwe na iṅwe.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Diversion ine ya ṱoḓea i ḓitika nga roof na system. Shumisani supplier sizing na maintenance instructions; a hu na volume nthihi ine ya shuma kha roof yoṱhe.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A diverter does not make the remaining water safe to drink.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Diverter a i iti uri maḓi o salaho a vhe o tsireledzea u nwiwa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Diverter a i iti uri maḓi o salaho a vhe o tsireledzea u nwiwa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tank size i ḓitika nga water demand, mvula, roof area na vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha dry periods.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tank size i bva kha water demand, mvula, roof area na vhulapfu ha dry periods.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ṅwalani mutevhe wa intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo u bva kha records dzaṋu vhaṋe. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ṅwalani intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa records dzaṋu. Vhambedzani na supply u mona na seasons.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Pulannani zwine na ḓo zwi ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi thoma u vha maṱuku. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi maḓi o vhulungwaho a tshi fhungudzea. Dzina ḽa province ḽiṱhihi a ḽi ni vhudzi tank size ine na i ṱoḓa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Itani uri tank i dzule yo tibifhiwa; screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Itani uri tank i dzule yo tibifhiwa; screen openings against insects, nahone ni maintain roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Vhudzisani local health authority nga ha testing na treatment yo teelaho intended use.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Maḓi ane a vhonala o kuna a nga kha ḓi vha na germs kana chemicals. Vhudzisani local health authority nga testing na treatment zwo teaho intended use.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Basic filter fhedzi a si drinking-water guarantee. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Basic filter fhedzi a si drinking-water guarantee. Maḓi ane a shumiswa kha food crops na one a ṱoḓa safety assessment.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Maḓi o shumiswaho hayani a nga vha na germs, salts, cleaning products na zwiṅwe zwithu. Tsivhudzo a i ṱalusi tshiko tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga nḓila nthihi. Tsivhudzo ya Afurika Tshipembe i fhambana nga ha maḓi a khishini na maḓi a u ṱanzwa zwiambaro.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Maḓi o shumiswaho hayani a nga vha na germs, salts, cleaning products na zwiṅwe zwithu. Tsivhudzo a i ṱalusi tshiko tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga nḓila nthihi. Tsivhudzo ya Afurika Tshipembe i fhambana nga ha kitchen water na laundry water.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ni songo katela toilet water, water from nappies, a u ṱanzwa muthu a lwalaho kana washing animals kha reuse plan. Ni songo dovha na shumisa maḓi a re na harmful chemicals.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Before any reuse, humbelani municipality na qualified local sanitation adviser uri vha ṱole exact source, household water na sanitation services, intended use na site. Arali nyeletshedzo iyi i siho kana i unclear, ni songo shumisa maḓi hafhu.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: A generic picture a si farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tshifanyiso tshi angaredzaho a si farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep wastewater away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Arali reuse system i tshi khou shuma nahone the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, litshani u a shumisa ni humbele qualified local advice.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: One kind of swale is a level trench on contour. It slows and spreads runoff so some water can soak into suitable soil. Other swales are designed with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Which approach fits your land depends on the soil, slope, drainage and storm flow. Have a trained local adviser check the line, overflow and receiving point before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Muxaka wun'we wa xisele (swale) i mugodi wo leha lowu ringaneke, lowu celiweke eka khanthura. Wu nonokisa mati lama khulukaka (runoff) wu tlhela wu ma hangalasa, so some water can soak into suitable soil. Swisele swin'wana swi dizayiniwa swi rhelela katsongo hi ndlela leyi lawulekaka, leswaku swi yisa mati lama taleke hi ku nonoka eka ndhawu leyi hlayisekeke yo huma. Ndlela leyi faneleke ndhawu ya wena yi titshege hi misava, ku rhelela, ku humesa mati na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela layini, ndlela ya mati lama taleke na ndhawu leyi ma yaka kona u nga si cela.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Muxaka wun'we wa xisele (swale) i a level trench on contour. Wu nonokisa mati lama khulukaka (runoff) wu tlhela wu ma hangalasa, leswaku some water can soak into suitable soil. Swisele swin'wana swi dizayiniwa with a slight, controlled grade to carry excess water slowly to a safe outlet. Ndlela leyi faneleke ndhawu ya wena yi titshege hi misava, ku rhelela, ku humesa mati na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela line, overflow na receiving point u nga si cela.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The excavated soil forms a berm on the downhill side, where trees can be planted when the site design is suitable.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Misava leyi celiweke yi endla khurhana ra misava (berm) etlhelweni ra le hansi, laha mirhi yi nga byariwaka kona loko dizayini ya ndhawu yi fanerile.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Misava leyi celiweke yi endla khurhana ra misava (berm) etlhelweni ra le hansi, laha mirhi yi nga byariwaka kona loko dizayini ya ndhawu yi fanerile.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Trees planted there may draw on moisture stored in the soil after rain, depending on the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mirhi leyi byariweke kona yi nga tirhisa ku tsakama loku hlayisiweke emisaveni endzhaku ka mpfula, swi ya hi ndhawu.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mirhi leyi byariweke kona yi nga tirhisa ku tsakama loku hlayisiweke emisaveni endzhaku ka mpfula, swi ya hi ndhawu.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mpfula ya matimba yi nga tata xisele hi ku hatlisa ku tlula hilaha mati ma nghenaka hakona emisaveni. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke u nga si cela.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mpfula ya matimba yi nga tata xisele hi ku hatlisa ku tlula hilaha mati ma nghenaka hakona emisaveni. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke u nga si cela.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ndlela ya kona a yi fanelanga ku kukula misava ya ndhawu yo rhelela kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka muakelani. Xisele kumbe damu leri nga ehansi swi fanele ku kota ku ma amukela hi vuhlayiseki.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ndlela ya kona a yi fanelanga ku kukula misava ya ndhawu yo rhelela kumbe ku rhumela mati lama onhaka eka muakelani. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela misava, ku rhelela na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Xifaniso a hi dizayini yo aka ha yona.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Kombela mutsundzuxi wa laha kaya loyi a leteriweke leswaku a kambela misava, ku rhelela na ku khuluka ka mati ya xidzedze. Xifaniso a hi dizayini yo aka ha yona.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Ku rhelela ntsena a ku ku byeli loko xisele xi fanerile. Misava, ku humesa mati, misava leyi nga tiyangiki na mati lama taka hi le henhla ka ndhawu yo rhelela hinkwaswo swa nkoka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ku rhelela ntsena a ku ku byeli loko xisele xi fanerile. Misava, ku humesa mati, misava leyi nga tiyangiki na mati lama taka hi le henhla ka ndhawu yo rhelela hinkwaswo swa nkoka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Hlayisa misava yi funengetekile kahle. Kuma nkambelo wa laha kaya u nga si cela eka steep, wet or unstable land. Mindzilakano ya byanyi (grass barriers) na titerasi (terraces) na swona swi lava dizayini leyi faneleke ndhawu.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Hlayisa misava yi funengetekile kahle. Kuma nkambelo wa laha kaya u nga si cela eka steep, wet kumbe unstable land. Mindzilakano ya byanyi (grass barriers) na titerasi (terraces) na swona swi lava dizayini leyi faneleke ndhawu.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam or pond can store runoff, but the amount available depends on local rain, the catchment, losses and how much water you use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Damu kumbe xidziva xi nga hlayisa mati lama khulukaka ehenhla ka misava, kambe ntsengo lowu kumekaka wu titshege hi mpfula ya le kusuhi, ndhawu yo hlengeleta mati (catchment), ku lahleka ka mati na leswaku u tirhisa mati yo tala njhani.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Damu kumbe xidziva xi nga hlayisa mati lama khulukaka ehenhla ka misava, kambe ntsengo lowu kumekaka wu titshege hi mpfula ya le kusuhi, ndhawu yo hlengeleta mati (catchment), ku lahleka ka mati na leswaku u tirhisa mati yo tala njhani.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Rainfall seasons differ across South Africa. Use local records and plan for dry periods; a full dam is not guaranteed.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tinguva ta mpfula ti hambana eAfrika Dzonga hinkwayo. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta le kusuhi naswona plan for dry periods; damu leri teleke a ri tiyisiwangi.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tinguva ta mpfula ti hambana eAfrika Dzonga hinkwaro. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta le kusuhi naswona plan for dry periods; damu leri teleke a ri tiyisisiwi.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before changing a watercourse or building storage works, check the required authorisation with the water authority.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Loko u nga si cinca watercourse kumbe ku aka storage works, kamba authorisation leyi lavekaka eka water authority.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: U nga si cinca watercourse kumbe ku aka storage works, kambela authorisation leyi lavekaka eka water authority.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A dam needs a site investigation and a design by a suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk and a safe spillway all matter.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Damu ri lava site investigation na design hi munhu loyi a nga na suitable qualifications. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway, hinkwato i swa nkoka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Damu ri lava site investigation na design hi munhu loyi a nga na suitable qualifications. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway, hinkwato i swa nkoka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not assume that annual rainfall tells you the size of a flood or the storage you will have.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: U nga ehleketi leswaku ntsengo wa mpfula ya lembe wu ku byela vukulu bya ndhambi kumbe vuhlayiselo lebyi u nga ta va na byona.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: U nga ehleketi leswaku ntsengo wa mpfula ya lembe wu ku byela vukulu bya ndhambi kumbe vuhlayiselo lebyi u nga ta va na byona.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Plan a safe route for excess water before construction.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke ngopfu u nga si sungula ku aka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Kunguhatela ndlela leyi hlayisekeke ya mati lama taleke u nga si sungula ku aka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water can be lost through evaporation and seepage. Check the water level and look for leaks or erosion.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mati ma nga lahleka hi evaporation and seepage. Kamba xiyimo xa mati naswona u lavisisa ku lutla kumbe ku gogodeka ka misava.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mati ma nga lahleka hi evaporation na seepage. Kamba mpimo wa mati naswona lavisisa ku huma ka mati kumbe ku kukuleka ka misava.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Hlayisa spillway yi nga pfaleki naswona hlayisa bank cover leyi boxiweke eka design. U nga byali mirhi ehenhla ka earth dam wall.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Their presence does not make the water clean or safe.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Ku va kona ka swona a swi endli mati ma basa kumbe ku hlayiseka.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Swiharhi swi nga onha tibangi ta damu na ku engetela vulongo ematini. Ku va kona ka swona a swi endli mati ma basa kumbe ma hlayiseka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Lwangu ra wena ri nga hlengeleta mati ya mpfula. Ntsengo wu titshege hi vukulu bya lwangu, mpfula na ku lahleka ka mati.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Lwangu ra wena ri nga hlengeleta mati ya mpfula. Ntsengo wu titshege hi vukulu bya lwangu, mpfula na ku lahleka ka mati.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Check whether the roof material is suitable for rainwater collection before connecting a tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Kamba loko switirhisiwa swa lwangu swi faneleka ku hlengeleta mati ya mpfula u nga si hlanganisa thanki.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Kamba loko switirhisiwa swa lwangu swi faneleka ku hlengeleta mati ya mpfula u nga si hlanganisa thanki.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tirhisa vukulu bya lwangu loko ri langutiwa hi le henhla na tirhekhodo ta mpfula ya le kusuhi. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tirhisa vukulu bya lwangu loko ri langutiwa hi le henhla na tirhekhodo ta mpfula ya le kusuhi. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: An annual total does not tell you how much water will be available during a dry spell. Compare supply with the uses you plan.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Ntsengo wa lembe hinkwaro a wu ku byeli leswaku ku ta kumeka mati yo tala ku fikela kwihi hi nkarhi wa dry spell. Pimanisa supply na ku tirhisiwa ka mati loku u ku pulaneke.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. First-flush diverter yi endla leswaku some of the first runoff yi nga ngheni etankini.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Roof runoff yi nga rhwala ntshuri, droppings na other contamination. First-flush diverter yi hambukisa mati man’wana ya runoff yo sungula leswaku ma nga ngheni etankini.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mati lama faneleke ku hambukisiwa ya titshege hi roof na system. Tirhisa milawu ya supplier ya sizing na maintenance; a ku na volume yin’we ya roof yin’wana na yin’wana.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A diverter does not make the remaining water safe to drink.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Diverter a yi endli leswaku mati lawa ma saleke ma hlayiseka ku nwa.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Diverter a yi endli leswaku mati lawa ma saleke ma hlayiseka ku nwa.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Sayizi ya thanki yi titshege hi xilaveko xa mati, mpfula, vukulu bya lwangu na vulehi bya dry periods.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Sayizi ya thanki yi titshege hi xilaveko xa mati, mpfula, vukulu bya lwangu na vulehi bya dry periods.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Tsala intended uses kutani u estimate demand ya wona u tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena n'wini. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Tsala intended uses kutani u anganyela demand ya wona hi ku tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena. Pimanisa supply na ku tirhisiwa ka wona hi tinguva.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Kunguhatela leswi u nga ta swi endla loko mati lama hlayisiweke ma sungula ku va matsongo. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Kunguhatela leswi u nga ta swi endla loko mati lama hlayisiweke ma sungula ku va matsongo. Vito ra province ntsena a ri ku byeli tank size leyi u yi lavaka.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Hlayisa thanki yi funengetiwile. Screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Hlayisa thanki yi funengetiwile. Screen openings against insects, naswona hlayisa roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mati lama vonakaka ma basile ma nga ha va na germs kumbe chemicals. Vutisa local health authority hi testing na treatment leswi fambisanaka na intended use.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A basic filter alone is not a drinking-water guarantee. Water used on food crops also needs a safety assessment.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Basic filter ntsena a yi tiyisisi leswaku mati ma hlayisekile ku nwa. Mati lawa ya tirhisiwaka eka food crops na wona ya lava safety assessment.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Basic filter ntsena a yi tiyisisi leswaku mati ma hlayisekile ku nwa. Mati lawa ya tirhisiwaka eka food crops na wona ya lava safety assessment.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Mati lama tirhisiweke ekaya ma nga va na germs, salts, cleaning products ni other substances. Swiletelo a swi hlamuseli swihlovo hinkwaswo hi ndlela yin’we. Swiletelo swa Afrika-Dzonga swa hambana hi mati ya le khixini ni mati yo hlantswa swiambalo.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Mati lama tirhisiweke ekaya ma nga va na germs, salts, cleaning products ni swilo swin’wana. Swiletelo a swi hlamuseli swihlovo hinkwato hi ndlela yin’we. Swiletelo swa Afrika-Dzonga swi hambana hi mati ya le khixini ni mati yo hlantswa swiambalo.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: U nga katsi mati ya toilet, mati yo huma eka nappies, mati yo hlantswa munhu loyi a vabyaka kumbe mati yo hlantswa swiharhi eka reuse plan. U nga tirhisi nakambe mati lama nga na harmful chemicals.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Before any reuse, kombela municipality na qualified local sanitation adviser ku kambela source leyi kongomeke, vukorhokeri bya mati na sanitation bya household, intended use na site. Loko ndzayo leyi yi nga kumeki kumbe yi nga ri erivaleni, u nga ma tirhisi nakambe.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: Xifaniso xa ntolovelo a hi pulani ya purasi. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: A generic picture a hi pulani ya purasi. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep wastewater away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.

paragraphs.sourceParagraph: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.currentParagraph: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
paragraphs.proposedParagraph: Loko reuse system yi ri karhi yi tirha naswona mati ma nunha, ma yima kumbe ma onha swimilana, tshika ku ma tirhisa kutani u lava ndzayo ya qualified local adviser.

Your roof can collect rainwater. The amount depends on roof area, rainfall and losses.

Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.

List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.

Greywater: Check Before Reuse
Greywater: Kambela u nga si ma tirhisa nakambe
machine-draft

Used household water can contain germs, salts, cleaning products and other substances. Guidance does not define every source in the same way. South African guidance differs on kitchen water and laundry water.

Do not include toilet water, water from nappies, washing a sick person or washing animals in a reuse plan. Do not reuse water containing harmful chemicals.

Before any reuse, ask the municipality and a qualified local sanitation adviser to check the exact source, the household's water and sanitation services, the intended use and the site. If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water.

A generic picture is not a farm design. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater. Keep it away from drinking-water plumbing and prevent contact with people or animals. Do not spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.

If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
